free_look_period.value: 15 days (30 days for policies with a term of 3 years if sold through distance marketing)
free_look_period.quote: The insured person shall be allowed free look period of fifteen days (thirty days for policies with a term of 3 years, if sold through distance marketing)

grace_period.value: 30 days (15 days in case of other than single premium policies)
grace_period.quote: can be renewed within the Grace Period of 30 days (15 days in case of other than single premium policies)

moratorium_period.quote: After completion of eight continuous years under the Policy no look back to be applied. This period of eight years is called as moratorium period.

summary.overview: ReAssure 2.0 is a comprehensive health insurance policy offering modern treatments, generous pre and post-hospitalization windows, and unique unlimited sum insured restoration benefits like ReAssure Forever. It provides flexibility in room selection and robust cumulative bonus options through Booster+.
best_for: Individuals looking for unlimited sum insured restoration features
Buyers wanting extensive pre and post-hospitalization coverage periods
Families seeking flexible room type options without standard room rent caps
watch_outs: Strict 30-day timeline for submitting reimbursement documents after discharge
Specific 24-month waiting periods apply to common treatments like cataracts and joint replacements
next_actions: Review the specific list of excluded consumable items in Annexure I
Check the zonal pricing category for your residential city
Evaluate whether optional covers like Safeguard or Safeguard+ fit your needs

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: Strict 30-day document submission deadline for claims
risks.explanation: All claim related documents must be submitted within 30 days from discharge, which can lead to claim delays or rejections if missed.
risks.quote: All documents MUST be submitted within 30 days from discharge.

risks.title: Room rent is capped
risks.explanation: Room rent is limited to Choose the room you like; the excess is yours to pay.
risks.quote: Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Pancreatitis and stones in biliary and urinary system, Cataract, glaucoma and retinal detachment, Hyperplasia of prostate, hydrocele and spermatocele, Prolapse uterus or cervix, endometriosis, Fibroids, Polycystic ovarian disease (PCOD), hysterectomy) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
